changes: Updated story_advance DONE handling to resolve the canonical git worktree root from nested directories, reject mismatched/non-story branches before any DONE mutation or auto-sync, use argv-safe git calls in destructive cleanup, and added worktree-authority smoke coverage plus CLAUDE.md lifecycle notes.
usage: Use Koala as before: run koala story_advance --storyId=<id> --phase=DONE from anywhere inside the story worktree. If the linked worktree is not on story/<storyId>, Koala now refuses before mutating state, merging, deleting the branch, or cleaning the worktree.
expectedOutcome: From a nested path such as .worktrees/B-xxx/PVSC, DONE output should mention the real .worktrees/B-xxx worktree, merge story/B-xxx to main, delete the branch, and avoid fatal git worktree remove .../PVSC warnings. On a wrong or non-story branch it should print refusing DONE cleanup before state mutation.
actualTranscript: npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke passed. The smoke exercises DONE from PVSC/child, wrong story branch behind main, and feature/not-story behind main; it verifies DONE metadata reaches main only on the expected story branch and wrong branches are not auto-merged or cleaned. koala validate --story=B-9e48 --json passed with 6/6 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match: canonical root cleanup works from nested cwd, and wrong/non-story linked worktree branches fail before DONE mutation or cleanup.
limitations: none — fully covered by focused smoke, reviewer gates, and koala validate for this lifecycle path
pitfalls: Several review rounds found earlier mutation windows: shell-interpolated git commands, non-story branch context returning null, autoSyncMain running before branch guard, and stale evidence after docs-only changes. Keep branch/freshness gates before every mutation.
